trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy and the platinum pops automatically — there is nothing extra to do. Work through the roadmap in order: story first, missables before the finale, then strangers, activities and collectibles, with 100% completion last. Expect a long hunt: 100% completion alone is the biggest single chunk of work.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening until the Gone Fishing mission and finish it. It is an early story mission, so you cannot miss it as long as you keep playing the story. No special preparation is needed — just follow the mission markers.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by completing its final story mission. Story trophies unlock as you play, so this one comes naturally on your first playthrough. If you are tracking progress, it marks the end of the opening act.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 by completing its final story mission. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable on a normal playthrough — keep following the story. The name is censored on PlayStation itself, asterisks and all, so do not be surprised when it pops that way.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 by completing its final story mission. You will reach it by playing the story in order; there is no side requirement. By now the map is wide open, so use the downtime between missions to start on collectibles.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 by completing its final story mission. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so it also signals that the endgame — and the missables — are near. Before you push on to the final mission, clear every trophy in roadmap stage 2.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the game. It unlocks at the end of the story, after Chapter 4. Do your missable trophies before starting it, since the post-game may not let you replay one-time moments.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission in the story. It is a story mission, so it unlocks as you play through the chapters. Expect an early-game job that sets up the partnership between the two leads.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist story mission. Heist missions usually need a little setup first — follow the mission chain until the heist itself triggers. Stock up on armor and a good getaway car before the job starts.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play story mission. It unlocks through normal story progress. The mission's name is a hint at its tone — expect family business, not a straight shootout.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners story mission. Keep playing the story and it will come. Headliners is a mid-story mission, so you will reach it during Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown story mission at Vice City International Airport. Expect a big set-piece — stock up on ammo and armor before you start it, and use the airport's cover rather than running across open tarmac.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory story mission. It is a late-story mission, so you will reach it in Chapter 4. The name suggests a heavy assault — bring your best weapons and a fast escape vehicle.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: finish the story, all stranger missions, activities, collectibles and challenges the game counts. This is the longest trophy in the list — use the in-game stats page to see what is still missing. Save it for last, after every other trophy, since it wraps up everything else.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, airtime and other stunt actions the game tracks. The fastest way is to chain stunt jumps and long airtime off ramps around Leonida in a fast car or bike. Check the stats menu to see your running total.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity once: races, fishing, arcade games, shooting range, drone races, bowling, meditation and the rest. You do not need to win or finish them — just start each one. Use the activities list in this guide as your checklist.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Practice each weapon class until you know the target patterns, and use the range's own scoring feedback to tighten your time. Gold needs clean accuracy, so slow down on the far targets rather than spraying.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Learn each course's racing line first with a slow lap, then push — the drones handle best with short, early turns. There is one race per location, so a win at each is all it takes.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — street, off-road, boat and air races all count, as long as each race is a different one. Rotate through the race types instead of repeating your favorite, and pick a vehicle class you are comfortable with.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges reward patience: watch the line tension, reel in during the slack and let the fish run when it surges. Cal is a rival angler, so the challenge is a head-to-head score, not just catching any fish.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — any machine in any arcade counts. Pick a short game, learn its controls in one run, then play a full game through to its end screen. The arcade cabinets are scattered through Vice City's bars and malls.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, one of the stranger mission strands. Stranger missions unlock as you explore Leonida and meet new characters — follow Andy's strand to its last mission. Check the map for his marker whenever you are in his part of the state.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is one of the stranger mission chains — keep returning to his missions as they appear on the map. The title is a hint that boats are involved, so be ready for a water chase.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand runs through the stranger missions, so finish each of his missions in turn until the finale. His chain leans on bikes, so keep a fast motorcycle handy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more than 8 strands in the game, so pick the ones you enjoy — each strand is a short chain of missions that ends with a finale. The five named stranger finals in this guide already count toward the eight.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is a stranger chain — work through his missions as they unlock across the map. Supply runs are his thing, so expect delivery and pickup jobs.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is another stranger chain; finish his missions in order until the last one. His missions turn up as you explore, so check the stranger markers regularly.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points on the map — visit each one and complete the meditation prompt. They are spread across the state, so this pairs well with exploring for the Goodtime State trophy.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret marks a rare animal for you — track it with the hunting clues, approach downwind and take a clean shot. Unique animals only appear for this hunt, so follow Bret's strand until he gives you the target.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, houses and odd corners — so collect them as you explore and check your collection to see which sets are close. Three finished sets is the target, not every card in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are the photo and check-in points scattered through the state — open your phone at each marked spot and take the shot. They are everywhere, so tick them off as you travel rather than hunting them all at once.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's small open-world tasks — stunts, races, hunts, collectibles and more — and they stack up as you play naturally. Check the challenges menu to see which ones you are close to finishing, then mop up the easy ones last.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get the heat up to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Do it during the story while partner missions are available — a 4-star escape is much harder to set up in free roam.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route past three close shops, hit them one after another and keep moving — lingering is what gets you caught. Do this while partner missions are still available, before the finale.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Vehicles count when you first drive them, so hop into anything new you see — traffic, parked cars, boats and bikes all add to the total. Driving a wide variety as you travel is the fastest way to reach 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a busy fight and line up your shots — five kills before the focus meter runs out. A mission with grouped enemies is the easiest place to do it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave the airport by an unofficial route instead of the normal exits. This is tied to a specific airport sequence, so do it when the opportunity appears during the story; after the finale the moment may not come back.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — take on the Rhino tank challenge. Rhinos are the military tanks, so expect heavy fire: use cover, keep moving and aim for the crew or the weak points the game highlights. The challenge is about surviving the encounter, not stealing the tank.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, enter quietly, avoid the cameras and staff sightlines, and leave before the alarm trips. If you are spotted the clean run is lost for that attempt, so save before you go in and retry if it goes loud.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are the big robbery targets — plan the approach, crack the vault, then lose the heat before the escape counts. Five successful vault jobs, each with a clean getaway, is the target.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes — block one, breach it, grab the cash and break away before the police box you in. Any truck counts, so pick a quiet stretch of road with a fast getaway car.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every named region of the map. Drive, fly or sail into each area until the map fills in; the game tracks which regions you have visited. Pair this with the WAiNK spots and meditation spots to cover the map efficiently.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs hidden operations around Leonida — find one per gang, hit it and get out. Gang territory maps in this guide show which crew controls which area, so work through the gangs one at a time.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the Ocean Beach bar area early in the game and order the cocktail at the right spot — it is a quiet opening moment, so do it during your first hours in Vice City before the story moves on.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side — it is a set-piece moment tied to a story sequence, so take it when the scene plays. After the finale the showroom moment may not be available.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. This is a story bowling-alley scene — play it through when it comes up in the story rather than leaving it for free roam. The follow-through is the story beat, not a free-play bowling game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This is a story moment about the partnership between the two leads — it unlocks through a specific story beat, so keep playing the story and it will come, but do not skip past the scene that sets it up.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). A story choice locks this one in — pick a side at the decision point and live with it. If you want the other outcome you will need a second playthrough or a save from before the choice, so keep a backup save.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This is a retry of a specific story moment — fail it once, then come back and nail it the second time. It only triggers around that one moment, so do not reload an old save past it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A one-time strange event out in Leonida — be in the right place at the right time and see it through. It is easy to walk past, so watch for the odd signal when you are exploring the state's wilder corners.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Drive past the bowling alley's pins and knock them down with a melee swing from the vehicle. It is tied to the bowling-alley sequence, so do it while that scene is available.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — pass them to your laundering contacts and the clean cash counts toward the total. Keep laundering as you earn; the total builds up over the whole game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars, food — every dollar at any shop counts. It adds up naturally, but big purchases like vehicles speed it along.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Garages go up for sale around Leonida as you progress — buy each one when it appears. They double as storage, so this also makes the vehicle trophies easier.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Photograph or scan ten different vehicles into the app — any ten count. Do it as you discover new vehicles for the Whip It Good trophy.
